prayerExcerpt.en-US: He preached the Faith in the countries of Agen, Anjou, and Beauvais, and being arrived at Amiens, there chose his residence, and founded there a numerous church of faithful disciples.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Pregou a Fé nas regiões de Agen, Anjou e Beauvais, e, tendo chegado a Amiens, ali escolheu sua residência, e fundou ali uma numerosa igreja de fiéis discípulos.

meta.face: A Navarrese of Pamplona of about forty, CLEAN-SHAVEN, with a sun-warm olive complexion and a LONG, NARROW face with a STRONG, PROJECTING CHIN — a high, narrow forehead, a LONG, STRAIGHT nose running from the brow with hardly a dip, NARROW-SET, bright black eyes under STRONGLY ARCHED, thick black brows, FLAT cheeks under clean cheekbones, a thin, firm, wide mouth, a long jaw ending in a DEEP, slightly jutting chin; thick, straight black hair cut short below the mitre; the gaze eager and bright, toward his people. Not the fair, long-faced thomas_becket, the young symphorian, or the hawk-nosed, bearded Eustachius of this batch.
meta.basis: The Amiens cathedral portal statue (French Wikipedia's lead) shows a young, clean-shaven bishop; the book and Wikipedia make him a native of Pamplona, so the card gives him a Navarrese face. Its structure is ours.
